name: Survey tile in Scorpius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.3 degrees south of the ecliptic in Scorpius, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 5 visits over 49 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 22 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.0 days starting 2025-07-28, at wavelengths from 1.14 to 4.75 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
